{"path":"todo_anthropic-claude-sonnet-5_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete, self-contained single-file Todo application (HTML + CSS + JS all in one file, no external dependencies).

Requirements:
1. Clean, modern, responsive UI centered on the page with a card-style container, nice color scheme (e.g. gradient background, white card), good typography, subtle shadows and transitions.
2. Header with app title "Todo List" (or similar) and an input form at top: a text input with placeholder "What needs to be done?" plus an "Add" button. Pressing Enter also adds the todo. Ignore empty/whitespace-only input.
3. Each todo item shows: a checkbox (custom styled) to toggle complete, the todo text (with CSS strikethrough + faded/gray color + reduced opacity when completed), and a delete button (e.g. an "×" icon button) that removes it, visible on hover or always visible.
4. Filter controls: three buttons/tabs "All", "Active", "Completed" that filter the visible list without losing data. Active filter button is visually highlighted (distinct style).
5. A footer/status area showing the count of remaining active (not completed) todos, e.g. "3 items left", and a "Clear completed" button that removes all completed todos (only enabled/shown when there are completed todos).
6. Persistence: all todos (id, text, completed) are saved to localStorage (key like "todos-app-v1") on every change (add/toggle/delete/clear), and loaded from localStorage on page load so state survives refresh.
7. Empty state: if there are no todos (for the current filter), show a friendly message like "No todos yet" / "Nothing here".
8. Implement everything in vanilla JavaScript (no frameworks/CDNs), using an array of todo objects with unique ids (e.g. Date.now() + random or incrementing counter), a render() function that rebuilds the list based on current filter, and event delegation for toggle/delete on the list container.
9. All CSS must be inside a single <style> tag in <head>, all JS inside a single <script> tag before </body>. The file must be fully self-contained (no external fonts/CDNs/links) and open correctly directly in a browser via file:// with no build step.
10. Include proper <!DOCTYPE html>, <html lang="en">, <meta charset="utf-8">, <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">, and a <title>Todo App</title>.

Produce the entire file content now."}
